description: Source code for the lexical analyzer component of the Lua programming language, implementing tokenization and string parsing functions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a character to the buffer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: luaX_init
methods.description: Initializes reserved keywords in the lexer.

methods.name: luaX_token2str
methods.description: Converts a token to its string representation.

methods.name: luaX_lexerror
methods.description: Handles lexical errors with detailed messages.

methods.name: luaX_newstring
methods.description: Creates a new string object in Lua from a C string.

methods.name: inclinenumber
methods.description: Increments line number and handles newlines.

methods.name: luaX_setinput
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with input source and state.

methods.name: luaX_lookahead
methods.description: Peeks at the next token without consuming it.
